_about: Refining (Dan, 2026-11-02; Godot build: game/systems/forge.gd), at any npc with `refiner: true` (a Refiner, a magical trade, not the smith). Each rank counts as +1 item level and the item's stats are worked out again by the item budget (docs/stats-and-damage.md); it extends the life of gear you already have, never makes one source of gear better than another. `caps` by rarity: how many ranks an item can take. `ranks` (one entry a rank, in order): coins, `chance` (percent to succeed), plus a count of Fellstones (`bands`: one material at every level since 2026-11-03; old dust and stone items have `becomes: fellstone` and turn into Fellstones on load), plus `coinsPerItemLevel` x level coins. A failed attempt only costs what was put in, never the item or a rank, and adds `resolvePerFail` percent to that item's next attempt (saved as rolls.resolve, cleared on success). From rank `announceFrom` a success is announced in the chat. An epic or legendary item's last rank (its cap) also needs `lastRank`. `scrap` breaks enhanced gear or better into `stones` of its band (a count by rarity) and `extra` for the rarities listed, gives back `refund` of the Fellstones spent on its successful ranks (failed tries are not refunded), and its gems; the window shows what you get first. Fellstones drop by `fellstoneDrops` (game/systems/loot.gd); Soulshards are end-game only (level 45+ dungeon bosses and rare elites).

fellstoneDrops._about: Fellstones fall only from enemies that still give you XP (Progression kill XP > 0: not grey). Chance by enemy kind; `boss` = type boss or a rare elite (`rare: true`), which always drop min..max.
